visual.name: radialHistogramCBT
visual.description: A histogram rendered as wedges radiating from a center point, with area-correct radius scaling by default.

dataRoles.name: values
dataRoles.description: The numeric field to bin around the circle.

dataRoles.name: weight
dataRoles.description: Sets each wedge's reach from the center. Set this field's aggregation to control how it's combined.

dataRoles.name: rowKey
dataRoles.description: Optional. A unique row identifier. Prevents rows with repeated values from being merged, and makes Average exact.

dataRoles.name: legend
dataRoles.description: Optional. Colors the wedges by category.

dataRoles.name: smallMultiples
dataRoles.description: Optional. Splits the chart into a grid of mini radial panels, one per category.

dataRoles.name: weightReference
dataRoles.description: Optional. Draws a reference spoke at each bound measure's value. Add more than one for multiple spokes.

absentSeries.description: Cumulative only. Drop: a series' band ends where its data ends. Carry: it keeps its running total to the end of the chart.

markStyle.description: Notch: a short tick across the outer ring. Spoke: a full line from the centre to the ring.

labelPlacement.description: In legend keeps the chart full size. Outside the ring costs radius, because the circle shrinks to make room for the text.
